issues.description: md-breakpoint crowding (768-~980px): the art zone starts at 55% of the viewport while the h1 box extends to px-6 + 700px, so full-strength field tiles and the acid signal tile (viewBox 660,180 -> ~x660/y223 viewport at 768px) can sit under or hard against the tail of the headline. Ink-on-acid contrast (~16:1) means no legibility failure, but the collision looks unconsidered at exactly md; at lg+ (px-16 gutters, wider zone) everything clears cleanly.
issues.resolution: Adopted the reviewer's first option: the field wrapper is now `hidden lg:block`, so neither field tiles nor the acid signal can render in the 768-1023px band where they could meet the headline box. At lg+ the geometry the reviewer verified as clearing cleanly is unchanged (signal stays embedded at 660,180 - now ringed by quincunx neighbours, a stronger 'in the field' position than an edge cell). The vacated md band carries the new slim signal strip instead (see issue 3).

issues.description: Field texture reads as a sparse medallion scatter rather than a woven tile field: 64px-diameter crescent-star medallions on a strictly row/column-aligned 120px pitch leave 56px gutters, producing a polka-dot rhythm. The spec's 'tile field' and the page feel would land harder with a denser, offset ground for the single signal to pop against.
issues.resolution: Field rewoven as a quincunx per the fixHint: rows y=60 and y=300 shifted x+60 (row A now 600/720/840/960, row C 480/600/720/840/960); the signal row y=180 is untouched, so the lit tile at (660,180) sits ringed by four half-pitch offset neighbours (600/720 above and below) plus its row mates. The two-tier 10%/5% dissolve and the omitted left cells are kept exactly as-is (op-5 dissolve cells now 600/300/480, same staggered left boundary shifted with their rows). Edge tiles land at x=960 and half-bleed off the right frame - the svg sits flush against the viewport edge, so the field reads as continuing beyond it. Same 15 uses, no node growth; left clearance vs the headline strictly improves (row A leftmost 540->600, row C 420->480).

issues.description: Below md the artwork is fully hidden (`hidden md:block`), so the Insights page carries zero Islamic-geometric identity on phones - the 'signal in the field' feel exists only on desktop/tablet, while every other page retains motif work in its section layouts on mobile.
issues.resolution: Added a slim signal strip in the page header, inside the container under the intro paragraph: a 480x72 aria-hidden focusable=false svg reusing the component's #insights-tf-tile def via <use> (the mechanism the fixHint prescribed) - three tiles at fill-current opacity-10 (x 60/180/420) plus one fill-acid signal at x=300 (inside the row, not at its edge), y=36, 120px pitch matching the field. `max-w-sm` keeps it <=58px tall so the header stays quiet. Gated `lg:hidden` rather than the hinted `md:hidden` because the issue-1 fix extends the artless range to <lg; the strip and the field are therefore mutually exclusive, and exactly one acid tile is visible at every viewport width. Zero raw colors; no copy touched.
